notes.title: Reviews Roulette: The one with tiny ghosts and egg murder
notes.content:
Reviews Roulette is where the RPS video department attempt to review all the random game keys that arrive unsolicited in their inbox. The hunt for hidden gems begins!

If you’re new here, or aren’t a viewer of our YouTube channel, then you might be unaware of something the RPS video team do on a semi-regular basis (listen, it’s hard to schedule regular features when you’re busy shrieking, and being problematic, and all the other things we YouTubers do.) It’s called Reviews Roulette, and the idea is to give airtime to some of the games we get in our inbox, but don’t have the proper time to cover.

We play each game for ten minutes, and then sometimes, sometimes, we will give them the “Daddy Wallace” award. Born out of me once mishearing Matthew when he said “Danny Wallace”. Now I’ve written it down, it does sound incredibly user-unfriendly. We will hold onto these in-jokes until we die.

notes.title: Hotfix - v1.0.2b
notes.content:
Couple of quick touch-ups again:

[list]
[*] [b]Adjusted background in Stage 1.[/b] Made an obvious looping point a little less obvious.
[*] [b]Adjusted last obstacle set in Stage 1.[/b] The jump up to the first tall stack of plates was too strict, requiring players to be practically off the short stack of plates to make the jump. This jump is now easier, so players can now focus more on the rest of the obstacle.
[/list]

See you next patch!

notes.title: Hotfix! v1.0.2 and Roadmap
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who's played my game so far! I've been keeping an eye on YouTube and Twitch these past few days and I found some things that needed a quick fix. I'd also like to take the time to address some outstanding bugs I've found, as well as my plans for the game down the road.

[b]v1.0.2 Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Adjusted foot collider for chicken.[/b] This should make it a little easier to climb over certain obstacles.
[*] [b]Slightly increased burger bounciness in Stage 2.[/b] Some obstacles will be harder, yes, but I felt the final obstacle was too hard otherwise.
[*] [b]"X" opacity decreased from 50% to 25%.[/b] Some players break so many eggs that they can't see the obstacles anymore. Expect a setting for this in the next major patch.
[*] [b]Added a checkpoint after the triple plates in Stage 1.[/b] There's too much of a difficulty spike at the end of the level otherwise, and I want more players to make it to Stage 2.
[*] [b]The credits now appear in the Level Select menu after finishing the game.[/b]
[/list]


[b]Outstanding Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]The chicken can get stuck walking across the manholes near the end of Stage 3.[/b] Yes, that's a bug, not a feature. Whoops!
[*] [b]The last grating in Stage 3 doesn't drop all the way down on occasion.[/b] This one's a mystery to me and will take some time to investigate.
[*] [b]Landing on a manhole in Stage 3 can sometimes causes an unexpected vertical launch.[/b] I suspect this happens when you land on a manhole that has just reached resting position.
[/list]

[b]Roadmap:[/b]
[list]
[*] Add some settings that are missing (volume, quality)
[*] Add controller support and keybinding
[*] Add Steam Achievements!
[*] Revamp Stage Select screen to include stats
[*] Introduce more playable characters and eggs
[*] (maybe) New set of stages? Like a New Game +?
[*] (maybe maybe) Custom stage builder?
[/list]

Hey you, thanks for reading to the end! Fun fact: using the Konami code in the main menu unlocks all the stages.
